evidence_basis: Chen et al. 2025 Nature 641 (PMID 40140574, DOI 10.1038/s41586-025-08794-6): same publisher PDF as the first receipt (SHA-256 4f4b0fb5b51392157bb83c2065f40d6508545daf1d4249ee93fb497b34419cd5, verified). This re-read adds the Methods body in full and the legends of Extended Data Figs 3 and 8; page images of Extended Data Fig. 3 (panel e) and Extended Data Fig. 8 (panel e at 260 dpi) were viewed in addition to the first receipt's Fig. 1 and Fig. 4. Figures are not scored read: only these images and legends, not every figure image. Supplementary: Source Data Extended Data Fig. 3 and Source Data Fig. 1 read in full by script, sheet names of Source Data Fig. 4, Supplementary Information (4 pages) and the text layer of Supplementary Fig. 1 (30 pages of uncropped blots); not read: Supplementary Tables 1 to 4, Source Data Fig. 2, 3 and Extended Data 1, 4 to 7, 9, and the image-only Reporting Summary. GEO series GSE268132, GSE268130 and GSE268127 were checked as record pages only (no data file downloaded; no series holds the R132H progenitor cultures). No blot quantified.
